project_title: Control Data Stock & Production - Automotive Manufacturing MES
theme: Industrial Dark Mode with Tactical High-Contrast Accents

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (Tactical Control Room)
layout_and_spacing.containers: Use sharp 1px borders with border-slate-800, subtle hover highlight, cardless or clean bounded surfaces with bg-slate-900/90
layout_and_spacing.header_navigation: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-950/90 border-b border-slate-800 px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between

visual_enhancers.card_style: High-density industrial panel with crisp 1px border border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-lg shadow-sm backdrop-blur-xs hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors
visual_enhancers.kpi_badges: Font-mono badge with glowing indicators: Emerald green dot for OK, Amber pulse dot for Low Stock, Red flashing dot for Shortage Critical
visual_enhancers.tables: Dense matrix tables with sticky header bg-slate-900/95, zebra rows bg-slate-950/40, monospace part numbers and quantities, badge status pills
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Smooth active state feedback on table filtering, Excel import drag-and-drop preview modal, animated KPI counters

key_features_and_modules.name: Dashboard & KPI Utama
key_features_and_modules.desc: Ringkasan Total Output SMT vs Target, Total Output LAMP ASSY, Total Shortage Items, Variance Stock, dan OEE/Efficiency Rate dengan grafik Trend Harian.

key_features_and_modules.name: Monitoring Produksi SMT
key_features_and_modules.desc: Tabel & visualisasi hasil produksi SMT per Lane (Lane 1 - Lane 4), Shift (Shift 1 - Shift 3), Part Number, Model/Type, Target vs Actual, Defect, Yield Rate.

key_features_and_modules.name: Monitoring Produksi LAMP ASSY
key_features_and_modules.desc: Tabel produksi per Line Lampu Otomotif (Head Lamp, Tail Lamp, DRL), Komponen SMT yang terpakai, Actual vs Target, Status Penyelesaian.

key_features_and_modules.name: Stock Monitoring SMT
key_features_and_modules.desc: Matriks stok bahan baku/komponen SMT (Reel/Tray), Safety Stock, Stock Aktual, Minimum Reorder Level, Status (AMAN, REORDER, CRITICAL).

key_features_and_modules.name: Kebutuhan Produksi vs Stock (Shortage Control)
key_features_and_modules.desc: Kalkulasi otomatis kebutuhan part berdasarkan MPS/Plan Produksi dibanding Stok SMT saat ini. Auto-highlight barang yang Kurang (Shortage).

key_features_and_modules.name: Laporan Variance Stock
key_features_and_modules.desc: Perbandingan Stock System vs Stock Fisik (Stock Opname), Selisih (Variance), Persentase Akurasi, dan Form Penyesuaian / Alasan Selisih.

key_features_and_modules.name: Import Excel/CSV & Form Input Manual
key_features_and_modules.desc: Fitur unggah laporan Excel harian (drag & drop) dengan pratinjau data & validasi otomatis, plus Form Input Manual cepat untuk SMT & Assembly.

key_features_and_modules.name: Filter Multi-Dimensi
key_features_and_modules.desc: Filter global: Tanggal / Range Tanggal, Shift, Sub-Line / Lane, Type Lampu / Car Model, Part Number, & Status Stock.

instructions_to_main_agent: Aplikasi adalah tool internal manufaktur otomotif profesional berbahasa Indonesia untuk Control Data Stock & Production (SMT & LAMP ASSY).
Pastikan layout sangat responsif, memiliki sidebar navigasi yang rapi, dan sticky top header dengan indikator user role (PPIC, PC, SMT, Assembly, Executive).
Semua tabel harus interaktif: pencarian instan, filter multi-dimensi (Tanggal, Lane, Model, Part Number, Status), sorting kolom, dan pagination.
Beri perhitungan otomatis: Variance = Stock Aktual - Stock System; Shortage = Stock SMT - Kebutuhan Produksi (highlight merah jika negative).
Sediakan modal/dialog untuk Import Excel/CSV dengan preview data tabel sebelum konfirmasi simpan.
Gunakan komponen Shadcn UI (Table, Dialog, Tabs, Select, Badge, Card, Popover, Input) yang telah distyle dengan tema dark industrial slate.
Tambahkan fitur filter cepat untuk memilih Perusahaan / Plant (misal: Plant 1 - SMT, Plant 2 - LAMP ASSY).
Setiap elemen interaktif (tombol, input, filter, tab, badge) WAJIB menyertakan attribute data-testid dalam kebab-case (contoh: data-testid='filter-part-number-input').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Create high-density tactical grids with structured borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add specific transitions like transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for icons. Use Lucide icons (e.g. Factory, Cpu, Layers, AlertTriangle, FileSpreadsheet, Download, RefreshCw).
Use 2-3x generous internal padding inside cards with borders to avoid text colliding with edges.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute for stable testing.
